name: remoteai
description: Chrome Remote Desktop-like access with file clipboard, SSH, and AI control

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,host -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @remoteai/server" "npm run dev -w @remoteai/web" "npm run dev -w @remoteai/host"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @remoteai/protocol && npm run build -w @remoteai/server && npm run build -w @remoteai/web && npm run build -w @remoteai/host
